The following events took place in '''36 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Supreme Chancellor election, 36 BBY/Legends|Chancery election]]; [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] was re-elected [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]].<ref name="TNEGTC" /> Shortly after the election he began a friendship with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].
*[[Naescorcom/Legends|Naescorcom]] constructed [[Ipsus]] on [[Genarius]].
*The [[Huk War]].
*[[Guther Bartyn]] was attacked when he was going to visit the family [[Mining/Legends|mines]] in [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="R">{{GamerCite|7|Reckonings}}</ref>
*[[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]] claimed to have received his last interesting [[Starship/Legends|starship]]-design contract from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], followed by at least seven [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of designs for the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], several mining firms and other buyers.<ref name="Rogue Planet">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref>
*Having convinced a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] to alter his records, a fifteen-year-old [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] applies to enter the [[Raithal Academy/Legends|Raithal Academy]].<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
